bullets.text: Minister R. Kumar participated in the 18th India Game Developer Conference at the Chennai Trade Centre, and the office should track related digital media initiatives.
A 21-year-old history-sheeter was hacked to death in Adyar, leading to three arrests and allegations against police, so the office should monitor law and order updates.
Public and media scrutiny has intensified over Velachery flooding and the Adyar murder case, requiring the office to watch administrative responses closely.
The mother of the deceased in Adyar accused an inspector of involvement while suspects circulated reels, and the office should watch the ongoing police investigation.
The corporation is seeking Metro's help to clear blockages in the Veerangal drain after twenty years, and the office should monitor this stormwater project.
Passengers fear a Chennai Airport shutdown during heavy rains as stormwater drain work drags on, and the office should watch mitigation progress.
The highways department closed potholes on the Tambaram-Velachery road using resin binder following complaints, and the office should track further road repairs.
Kosasthalai river banks face breach risks and Puzhal surplus canal encroachments threaten Thiruvottiyur and Manali, so the district team should watch flood preparations.
Avadi councillors protested with whistles after three power cuts occurred during the municipal meeting, and the office should monitor local civic utility stability.
Suburban train services were disrupted due to a broken overhead cable between Washermenpet and Royapuram, and the office should track rail restoration.
Chief Minister Vijay inaugurated new skill training labs at the Guindy ITI campus, and the portfolio team should track employment generation programs.
OneQode secured 14 MW of Chennai AI capacity in an agreement with AdaniConneX, and the office should monitor regional infrastructure investments.
A Chennai IIT professor called for a separate institution to verify AI-generated facts, and the portfolio team should watch policy developments in artificial intelligence governance.
The CPI accused the government of moving towards privatization during a protest in Vyasarpadi, and the office should monitor political criticisms.
MP Kanimozhi criticized the government for failing to control Aavin product prices, and the office should watch opposition statements.
Speaker J.C.D. Prabhakar stated that a new era has dawned in Tamil Nadu during an event in Minjur, and the office should track positive stakeholder engagements.
